The description for the dark blue line ('5 Силно несъгласен') states that the value 'remains' at 12% for the '35-44' group. This is incorrect; the line increases from 2% (in the '26-34' group) to 12%.
The color of the line '3 Не мога да прецена' is described as 'сиво-сиво' (gray-gray), which is an awkward and repetitive phrasing. 'Сива' (gray) would be sufficient and more natural.
The description does not mention that the y-axis has no numerical labels for its scale, only gridlines. It incorrectly states the range and intervals as if they were explicitly labeled.

In the description of the dark blue line ('5 Силно несъгласен'), it incorrectly states the line begins at 28%. The line begins at 25%. This error also duplicates a value from another line ('1 Силно съгласен').
